title: Laguna Beach UAP data-collection mission

tellings.quote: we spent 5 days on a rooftop in Laguna Beach observing the sky,

plain: A physicist named Kevin Knuth says that in 2021 he and a team spent five days on a rooftop in Laguna Beach, California, watching the sky for UAP, the newer official term for UFOs. He connects the effort to Matthew Shadagus and to a project called A Tear in the Sky. The point, he says, was to collect real scientific data on strange objects in the sky.
